# #687 GI Cell-click wrapper prerequisite

Read-only original/source research, 2026-10-03. Owned worktree /Users/halvor/Documents/vera20k-worktrees/vera20k-height, HEAD 4475a1a73afbfc0ae7b289deeb58368e7b9b1050 plus Root/native-owner WIP. This is prerequisite research, not the current chain's critic. No repository edits, Cargo, game, native execution or Ghidra mutation. Original listings were read with explicit program gamemd.exe; file-backed bytes were checked through existing native_oracle.image_bytes/file_span. No new mapper, classifier or native fixture was made.

## Original click boundary

Infantry class +0x140 = 0x51F250; +0x70 = 0x51F800 on the produced E1 vtable 0x7EB058 (existing initialized controls). For entry stack S, the click has four dwords: original action [S+4], Cell pointer [S+8], third argument [S+12], fourth argument [S+16].

- 51F25D..51F275 reads instance Doing +0x6C4 and tests exactly 27,28,29,30. Outside that family it proceeds directly to Berserk.
- Inside the family, 51F277..51F282 calls the current class +0x70(Cell,0,fourth click argument); 51F282..51F28C rejects only returned action2, by XOR AL,AL and true RET16. This guard does not locally test a human owner or inspect the supplied action argument.
- 51F28F..51F29E independently rejects Techno +0x298 Berserk. Otherwise 51F2A1..51F2AF forwards all four original arguments to Foot 0x4D7D50; true RET16 is 51F2B7.
- Foot itself re-queries class +0x70(Cell,0,fourth argument) at 4D7D96..4D7DA6. Its live answer in EBP drives switch 4D7DCC..4D7DE0, rather than a guessed admission meaning for EAX or the supplied action. The original two switch bytes are action1 -> table slot0 -> 4D7EB5, action2 -> slot1 -> 4D8065. Both may reach the same existing Foot resolver 4DE1D0. Therefore globally rejecting action2 would be wrong; the selected Infantry Doing-family/query2 gate is specific.
- OS Shift is not the click's fourth argument in the retained controls: WhatAction args are [Cell,0,0], click args are [queried_action,Cell,0,0], with literal key0x10 SHORT8000 supplied only at original GetKeyState. Original Options and key-owner code reads modifiers internally. Do not assign a modifier name to the unnamed fourth argument from its position.

## Relevant +70 dependency and existing state owners

51F800 first calls House 50B6F0 at 51F80E. If false it returns full EAX0 at 51F81F without Foot/Techno WhatAction. If true, 51F833 calls Foot 4DDDE0, whose 4DDDF9 calls Techno 700600. Foot can replace the base answer for shroud; preserve that result, not merely Techno's literal Shift shortcut.

51F8A8..51F8C9 checks House 50B6F0 again and Type +0xEC8. For that human/Deployer arm, 51F8CF..51F8E7 tests Doing27..30; 51F8ED..51F94E maps base action1 to action2. Base action5 additionally depends on Type +0x6AC and the actual virtual +0x164 query before replacement. Other actions and non-Deployer types follow later native branches. This explains why literal Shift's Techno/Foot action1 does not bypass the Infantry wrapper. It does not establish every action, shroud, type, modifier or controller contrast.

Deployer is exact-case native key at 0x825928. InfantryType ctor 5236A7 clears EBX; 5237CF stores BL=0 at +0xEC8. InfantryType ReadINI 524606 loads the current field as default, 524615 calls ReadBool5295F0([type+0x24],"Deployer",current), and 524620 stores AL. Production ObjectType.deployer lives at object_type.rs:1146/2507. IniSection::read_bool (ini_value.rs:94..105) folds actual rule layers with native first-character parsing: 1/T/Y true,0/F/N false; missing,empty,other first byte retain the current default. No clamps. Existing initialized-no_rally native input receipt records E1 Deployer=yes in physical RULESMD; absent LANGRULE, mode MPBattleMD and Hills.map have no later E1 section. This is saved-reader/cache evidence, not grep or a newly executed read. The current compact GI type projection does not separately expose the +EC8 byte; retain its original reader/bootstrap receipt with the new tests.

House 50B6F0 differs from House 50B730:
- 50B6F0: GameMode [A8B238]==0 -> byte house+1EC OR house+1ED; nonzero mode -> owner pointer equals currentHouse [A83D4C] (50B716..50B723).
- 50B730: nonzero mode returns house+1EC; mode0 uses the same OR.
Existing Simulation::house_is_human_player (world_orders.rs:74..85) owns the first predicate and uses persisted Session.current_house. HouseState::is_controlled_by_human (house_state.rs:717) owns the second predicate. Never substitute presentation viewer or the class setter's second predicate here.

Berserk +0x298 already lives in entity.berserk.active (GameEntity BerserkState:232, field:904, constructor:1700). Its signed timer +29C and update/damage lifecycle remain with that owner; this input check needs no new state. Doing remains Infantry action/mission-leaf state; Deployer remains production retail ObjectType, not an instance mirror.

## Rust input boundary and recommendation

commands::ordinary_cell_move_goal (:837) is the Cell-click producer, before local Event encoding; Simulation::ordinary_ground_foot_cell_input (:18) owns its bounded ordinary-ground classification and 4DE1D0 resolver. At inspection the latter passes action1 without these Infantry wrappers. This is the appropriate existing composition to extend with the selected native +70/51F250 decision, using the owners above; app code should only supply its actual click/modifier context and consume the result. Keep the 51AA40 class setter's independent Doing/control refusal in its owner, and never suppress decoded/replay/internal Move there from an input-only rule.

All four context_order producer calls funnel through commands at :692 (non-miner mixed ore click), :786 (mixed building rally/mobile move), :1215 (unarmed Cell force-fire fallback), :1236 (ordinary Move path). context_order reads held Ctrl/Shift/Alt at :524 and maps Queue at :585; Alt object input and AttackMove have explicit separate caller boundaries. Literal Shift GI cell Move normalization already reaches the same owner. Do not add repeated Deployer/Doing classifiers in these four app arms or use infantry_setter_receiver's later class availability as the click admission predicate.

The existing app cursor what_action_on_cell (:317) is an approximate generic classifier and has no Infantry Deployer/Doing wrapper. Do not copy its Techno terrain ladder into a second classifier. A shared class-action result belongs with the simulation input/query owner; any later cursor use should consume that result, while its presently separate broad cursor coverage remains explicitly bounded. This packet does not claim whole input/cursor equivalence.

## Executed receipts and essential contrasts

Accepted plain human_Doing27_B is in _walk_first_path/accepted/human_Doing27_B-r7-retry1.json.gz, SHA256 81867518c9bef5e01f347c561db550ad0e88124f87bf5d2e7b7296a30102b7c7, source_boundary as-run-r7 in existing manifest. Actual DoAction(27,1,0) succeeds; original Techno/Foot returns1, GI returns2; click re-query GI2 returns0 before Foot click/resolver/Event/class. Queued−1/Guard5, Nav/head/timers/vector state and all3 RNG stay unchanged. A preceding bootstrap timeout did not reach this control and proves no gameplay answer.

Native owner separately reports actual literal Shift control human_Doing27_shift_B-r8.json.gz, SHA256 153e10257986b72d361847e6e5f377b9f1dc6659d3957d72a41e31cb3592a5d3: same Techno/Foot1 -> GI2, click rejection, no downstream event/mission/class and full state/RNG retained. Its publication/check is owned by the native agent; this note did not run it.

Required contrasts remain original currentHouse/GameMode selector, non-Deployer, Doing outside27..30, different current +70 action/fourth argument, Berserk and direct class-only destination. A non-Deployer Doing27 input can pass this specific wrapper yet a later human-controlled51AA40 may refuse after Event's mission/target prewrites. Do not collapse that ordering into an unconditional input human/Doing refusal. These unexecuted contrasts are source-established branch prerequisites, not new numeric/RNG parity claims.
